title: French Crumble Crostini
description: A simple French appetizer featuring toasted bread topped with a mixture of crumbled cheese and caramelized onions.
instructions: Slice the brioche bread into 1/2-inch thick rounds and toast until lightly browned.
In a pan over medium heat, caramelize the sliced onions with butter until golden brown.
In a separate bowl, mix together the crumbled Gruyère cheese and flour.
To assemble the crostini, place a toasted bread round on a baking sheet and top with a spoonful of caramelized onions and a sprinkle of cheese mixture.
Bake for 5-7 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
